entry.title: [fixture] Tightly coupled visual-inertial odometry for fast quadrotor flight
entry.summary: We present a visual-inertial odometry method for quadrotor flight with fast motion. We report ATE RMSE on EuRoC and TUM-VI with an ablation study and compare against OpenVINS. Open-source code is released, with a ROS 2 wrapper and real-world flight experiments on an onboard Jetson.

entry.title: [fixture] Event camera odometry with IMU preintegration on a UAV
entry.summary: An event camera odometry pipeline fused with inertial measurements for a UAV in low light. A new dataset is released together with benchmark results and documentation.

entry.title: [fixture] GNSS-denied navigation for a drone with a learned inertial odometry prior
entry.summary: A drone navigates without GNSS using a learned inertial odometry prior and visual-inertial odometry. How to reproduce: code released with a changelog and a migration note for the calibration format, a breaking change.
